method: V12 compass set with a corrected GPT Image 2 horizontal left endpoint; the final right endpoint is a direct masked GPT Image 2 high-quality edit of an exact horizontal mirror of that accepted left asset, with changes restricted to internal hair, lens, collar, fold, button, and pocket details; the accepted right-to-bottom-right midpoint is uniformly aligned to the new endpoint

constraints.uniformResize: left generation source: 1280x1280 to 1254x1254; mirrored-right Image API input: 1254x1254 to 1280x1280, accepted generated source: 1280x1280 to 1254x1254; accepted right-to-bottom-right midpoint: final uniform 1254x1254 to 1273x1273 endpoint-alignment scale

inputs: prior V13 left endpoint: edit target for framing, scale, crop, shoulders, wardrobe, and horizontal pose correction
top-left.webp: fixed hair-only reference for crown height, width, side fullness, texture, and identity
center.webp: supporting identity, lighting, and wardrobe reference

regeneratedEndpoints.mirroredBase: exact horizontal mirror of left.webp before the Image API edit
regeneratedEndpoints.editMask: the subject silhouette and spatial geometry are locked; editable regions expose only internal crown strand groupings, lens interiors, local collar and overshirt folds/buttons, and the lower pocket regions
inputs: exact horizontal mirror of left.webp: masked edit target and absolute authority for pose, identity, face/head scale, hair silhouette, shoulder span, torso, collar, subject placement, and crop
top-right.webp: fixed supporting reference only for natural right-side crown texture and strand variation
center.webp: fixed supporting identity, lighting, and wardrobe reference only
bottom-right.webp: fixed supporting reference only for natural lens reflections and screen-right pocket placement

rebuiltTransition.alignment: retained the accepted GPT Image 2 midpoint content, uniformly resized the keyed 1254x1254 frame to 1273x1273, selected the 1254x1253 visible region beginning at x=14, y=0, and added one transparent top row; no anisotropic warp or content regeneration
inputs: corrected right endpoint source: authoritative start pose, identity, scale, hair, wardrobe, lighting, and framing
bottom-right.webp: authoritative end pose, scale, placement, hair, wardrobe, lighting, and framing
center.webp: supporting identity and wardrobe reference
